'Things got out of control': Video of alleged beating by Santa Ana police spurs investigation

Santa Ana authorities are investigating after a video circulated online of officers allegedly beating a man during his arrest.

Santa Ana officials were investigating Monday after a video circulating on social media appeared to show two police officers throwing a suspect to the ground and beating him.

The occasionally shaky video shows the officers holding 28-year-old Florentino Junior Lopez against the hood of a police car.

“All of the sudden, things got out of control,” said Lopez’s attorney, John Kremer.

After Lopez says something to the officers, he is yanked to the ground and punched repeatedly. The incident ended when two other officers arrived  to restore order, at which point Lopez was handcuffed, Kremer said Monday evening.

The incident took place  around 9:30 p.m. Thursday outside the Santa Ana home where Lopez lives with his parents and sister, according to the attorney.
